scope: Ten bounded CPU operations for spectral/functional preprocessing and sampled-grid analysis. Partial JMP19.2 FDE-related method coverage, not complete FDE equivalence.
integration_status: pubmod and publicexecute dispatch enabled by parent; all13focused tests green. Native SQL validation is parent-owned.

common_contract.data: Finite nonempty rectangular data,<=10000rows,<=1024columns,<=1000000cells; normally one curve per row, DTW uses a long[value,id]table.
common_contract.result: Version1JSON or Rust Result error. Undefined variance/rank,nonfinite derived quantities and supported workload limits return errors.
common_contract.work: SG/DFT/gridPCA use a50000000 nominal work guard; DTW has<=4000000cellpairs; prominence scans<=50000000steps; PCA eigensolver<=80cyclicsweeps on dimension<=128.
common_contract.units: Origins and mean offsets stabilize centering. No missing-data imputation or grid inference; supplied samples are interpreted as equally spaced.
common_contract.automatic_training: MSC mean reference and FPCA use all supplied curves. MSC explicit reference avoids query-driven fit; there is no implicit holdout split.

operations.description: Per-spectrum standard normal variate: curve rows on a common grid; [variance_ddof=1].
operations.data: Each row one spectrum; at least2 samples per spectrum.
operations.estimator: Center each spectrum and divide by its own SD, using origin-relative centering and scaled squared norms. Constant spectra are rejected.

operations.description: MSC reference regression: curve rows; [] fits their mean reference, or args are the saved reference spectrum.
operations.data: Each row one spectrum with>=2 samples.
args: Either[] or exactly one reference intensity per sample column
operations.estimator: Regress each y on intercept+reference r and return(y-intercept)/slope. No arguments fits a mean reference from all supplied curves. Supplying the returned reference_parameters reuses that reference without query-driven fitting. Zero reference variance or zero slope is an error.
unsupported: automatic validation-set separation when fitting mean reference

operations.description: Fixed Savitzky-Golay filter or derivative: equally spaced curve rows; [odd_window,degree=2,derivative=0,spacing=1].
operations.data: Each row one equally spaced curve.
operations.estimator: Local least-squares polynomials via twice-reorthogonalized QR; analytical derivative and interpolation edge fits using first/last full window. Matches scipy.signal.savgol_filter(mode=interp) settings; fixed user parameters.

operations.description: Finite curve derivatives: equally spaced curve rows; [order=1,spacing=1].
operations.data: Each row one curve with>=3 samples.
operations.estimator: Repeated numpy.gradient-style second-order central first derivative with second-order one-sided endpoint stencils. Order2 repeats that operator; it is not a direct five-point second-derivative formula.

operations.description: Global polynomial baseline removal: curve rows; [degree=1] on a normalized equally spaced grid.
operations.data: Each row one curve with>=2 samples.
operations.estimator: Fit a global unpenalized polynomial on sample locations normalized to[-1,1] via QR. Return fitted baselines,residual rows,and coefficients ordered ascending powers. This is a user-selected polynomial baseline rather than JMP automatic baseline correction.
operations.known_value: Quadratic baseline removed to numerical zero.

operations.description: Orthonormal Haar forward/inverse: power-of-two curve rows; [inverse=0,levels=full].
operations.data: Each row one curve or Haar coefficient vector with length2..1024,power of2.
operations.estimator: Orthogonal Mallat ordering: coarse approximation followed by detail bands from coarse to fine. Partial levels preserve remaining finest detail layout; inverse must receive the same levels.

operations.description: Direct discrete Fourier forward/inverse: real curve rows or packed complex rows; [inverse=0].
operations.data: Forward rows1..512real samples. Inverse rows pack all real coefficients then all imaginary coefficients,even width<=1024.
operations.estimator: Unscaled negative-sign forward DFT; positive-sign inverse divided by n. Forward rows contain packed real+imaginary coefficients. Inverse rows contain real values and imaginary_rows retains the complete complex inverse.

operations.description: Pairwise DTW distance and path: [value,series_id0or1] rows; [window_radius=unbounded].
operations.data: Long rows[value,series_id0or1]; preserve each series order; unequal lengths supported. Both series nonempty.
operations.estimator: Endpoint-to-endpoint dynamic program with diagonal/vertical/horizontal steps, squared amplitude difference local cost, square root of total cost returned. Sakoe-Chiba index window, deterministic diagonal/up/left ties. No path-length normalization. Internal origin/scale only stabilize arithmetic.

operations.description: Common-grid functional PCA: curve rows; [components,spacing=1], trapezoid L2 metric.
operations.data: At least2curves and2samples; min(curves,samples)<=128. All supplied curves train the decomposition.
args: components: required integer1..min(curves-1,samples),must not exceed numerical covariance rank
operations.estimator: Center grid columns, multiply by square-root trapezoid weights, eigendecompose the smaller sample/feature Gram matrix, and convert Euclidean loading vectors to L2-normalized grid eigenfunctions. Sample covariance denominatorn-1. Return scores,mean curve,eigenvalues and reconstruction.
unsupported: JMP smoothed direct FPCA/BIC component selection

operations.description: Sampled local peaks with global prominence: curve rows; [minimum_prominence=0,minimum_distance=1].
operations.data: Each row one curve with>=3samples. Endpoints are excluded as peaks.
operations.estimator: Local maxima include plateaus represented by their lower middle index. Height-prioritized distance filtering occurs before global topographic prominence; equal-height priority chooses lowest index. Bases stop at higher peaks; equal-height peaks are ignored.
unsupported: equal-height distance tie equivalence to SciPy
